```sql
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           count(DISTINCT o.id)        AS order_count,
           sum(ol.quantity)            AS quantity,
           sum(ol.line_total_cents)    AS revenue_cents,
           count(DISTINCT pv.id)       AS variant_count
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY pv.product_id
     ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
     LIMIT %(limit)s
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       agg.order_count,
       agg.quantity,
       agg.revenue_cents,
       agg.variant_count
  FROM agg
  JOIN products p ON p.id = agg.product_id
 ORDER BY agg.quantity DESC, agg.revenue_cents DESC
```

De aggregatie en de LIMIT gebeuren nu op `pv.product_id` (een uuid) in plaats van op vijf brede tekstkolommen van `products`. De `products`-tabel wordt pas voor de top-N rijen gejoind. Omdat `product_variants.product_id` NOT NULL is met een FK, blijft het resultaat gelijk; alleen de volgorde bij exact gelijke `quantity` én `revenue_cents` was al niet gedefinieerd.
